mapper.insert: /* Baim01Mapper.mergeSiteInfo */ INSERT INTO TB_SITE ( SITE_CD , SITE_NO , SITE_NM , CMPNY_CD , ADDR_1 , ADDR_2 , ZIP_CODE , STR_DATE , END_DATE , USE_YN , SITE_ADMIN_ID , TEL_NO , GPS_RANGE , SITE_DESC , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{param.siteCd} , COALESCE(NULLIF(#{param.siteNo}, ''), #{param.siteCd}) , #{param.siteNm} , #{token.gv_cmpnyCd} , #{param.addr1} , #{param.addr2} , #{param.zipCode} , REPLACE(#{param.strDate}, '-', '') , CASE WHEN #{param.useYn} = 'Y' THEN NULL ELSE DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') END , #{param.useYn} , #{param.siteAdminId} , REPLACE(#{param.telNo}, '-', '') , #{param.gpsRange} , #{param.siteDesc} , #{token.gv_userId} , NOW() , #{token.gv_userId} , NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SITE_NO = VALUES(SITE_NO) , SITE_NM = VALUES(SITE_NM) , ADDR_1 = VALUES(ADDR_1) , ADDR_2 = VALUES(ADDR_2) , ZIP_CODE = VALUES(ZIP_CODE) , STR_DATE = VALUES(STR_DATE) , END_DATE = VALUES(END_DATE) , USE_YN = IFNULL(USE_YN, 'Y') , SITE_ADMIN_ID = VALUES(SITE_ADMIN_ID) , TEL_NO = VALUES(TEL_NO) , GPS_RANGE = VALUES(GPS_RANGE) , SITE_DESC = VALUES(SITE_DESC) , UPDATE_NO = VALUES(UPDATE_NO) , UPDATE_DATE = VALUES(UPDATE_DATE)

/* Baim01Mapper.mergeMasterSiteAuthSet */ INSERT INTO TB_USER_SITE_AUTH ( CMPNY_CD , USER_ID , SITE_CD , USE_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.USER_ID , #{param.siteCd} AS SITE_CD , 'Y' AS USE_YN , #{token.gv_userId} , NOW() , #{token.gv_userId} , NOW() FROM TB_USER A WHERE AUTH_CD IN ('00001', '00000') /* 마스터 권한 사용자, 시스템 관리자 게정 */ ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE USE_YN = VALUES(USE_YN) , UPDATE_NO = VALUES(UPDATE_NO) , UPDATE_DATE = VALUES(UPDATE_DATE)
